parameters.name: cnpj_cpf
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const v = $('Normalizar Sofia').item.json.cpf_cnpj?.toString().replace(/\D/g,''); if(!v)return''; if(v.length===11)return v.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{2})/,'$1.$2.$3-$4'); if(v.length===14)return v.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{4})(\d{2})/,'$1.$2.$3/$4-$5'); return v; })() }}

parameters.name: id_tipo_contrato
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const v = Number($('Normalizar Sofia').item.json.data_vencimento); const m = {5:5,10:75,15:15,20:20}; return m[v]??75; })() }}
